turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
I'm getting dozens of these essays now. What would a fair process for catching AI writing look like? What would you put in the policy?
Your school already has one, and 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in. I'm not here to fix the rest of your stack. What do you have on Owen's essay?
